text:
cheng: quick heads-up from today's onboarding smoke for hippo-3b-ptq (nf4-8bit). seeing structured action responses drop the last element or reorder keys in ~3% of samples when streaming is enabled. posting small example below.

eva: can you paste the prompt + runtime flags?

cheng: short prompt, nothing fancy. runtime args: --quant=ptq --stream=true --kvcache=enabled --temp=0.0.

cheng: expected payload (float baseline):
```json
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "open_ticket", "metadata": {"priority": "low"}},
    {"id": "summarize", "metadata": {"len": 120}},
    {"id": "notify", "metadata": {"channel": "#ops"}}
  ]
}
```

cheng: observed payload (ptq + streaming):
```json
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "open_ticket"},
    {"id": "summarize", "metadata": {"len": 120}}
  ]
}
```

sam: interesting — missing metadata on first action and length reduced. does disabling streaming make it go away?

cheng: yeah, quick local check: with --stream=false the outputs align with baseline. failure rate drops to ~0.1%.

maya: could be a stream-chunk boundary that truncates a trailing JSON fragment, then the post-processor re-parses and drops malformed tail. did you capture the raw token stream?

cheng: captured a few samples. here's a snippet of the tokenized tail where we see a truncated object boundary:
```
... , "notify": {"channel": "#ops"} 
}




````
(so we see an extra newline and then stream ended mid-token in some runs)

infra-bot: deployment note: hippo-ptq-01 pool scaled 1->3 for the smoke run.

eva: plan: (1) reproduce with streaming disabled/forced, (2) run token-level capture on a small batch with streaming on to inspect boundaries, (3) run sample harness of 2k requests comparing hippo-ptq vs hippo-fp32.

sam: also add a kernel/runtime check — quantized kernels sometimes change buffer sizing. can you capture kernel selection logs? set EXPORT_KERNEL_TRACE=1 for the run.

cheng: filed infra issue #3241 for kernel trace and buffer sizing reproducer, assigned to @sam. smoke-run id: 1765004321-hippo-ptq-struct-v1. command I'm running: `./tools/eval_structured --model hippo-3b-ptq --samples 500 --batch 1 --streaming true --capture-tokens token-dump/1765004321`

maya: I'll run the sample harness against the float baseline and the ptq model with streaming off/on and produce a tiny confusion matrix for missing fields by EOD. :thumbsup:

eva: if this is indeed a streaming boundary issue, mitigations: a) disable streaming for structured routes by default until we have a robust NDJSON/stream-reassemble layer, b) add a quick parse-rescue that waits for closing brackets (small timeout) and retries parse, c) augment postprocess to prefer schema-complete objects when merging fragments.

sam: agree. also check tokenizer upgrade differences between builds — a token split change could move a comma/bracket to a different token that triggers different chunking.

cheng: created a quick parse-rescue PR that tries a lightweight suffix-append ("\n]\") when parse fails and records the raw tokens to S3. will open a follow-up if the kernel repro shows a deeper issue.

ops-bot: note created: SRE ticket 2026-178 for runtime fallback policy review.

maya: quick question — are we seeing schema key reordering (which breaks exact string matching) or element loss?

cheng: mostly element loss (last action missing) and occasional key-order changes inside objects that our strict schema checker flags. both reduce pass-rate on structured-evals.

eva: OK — let's triage in this order: reproduce deterministically (stream=false, temp=0), capture token/kernels with streaming true, run the parse-rescue patch on a small canary, then decide rollback if fail-rate > 1%.

cheng: agreed. posting logs and token dumps to the issue as I run. will update thread when I have the harness results.

maya: thanks — ping me when results are up, I'll prepare the eval diff for the dashboard.

sam: assigned tasks: kernel repro (sam), parse-rescue review (cheng), sample harness + dashboard diff (maya), token capture + S3 upload (cheng).

cheng: thanks all. short-term mitigation: disabling streaming on the structured route for hippo-3b-ptq until we confirm.

maya: noted, I'll coordinate the route flag flip with infra once we have confirmaiton.

cheng: closing loop — I pushed an initial batch of token dumps to s3://redwood-smoke/1765004321/ and linked them on issue #3241.

infra-bot: reminder: remember to include a rollback plan when toggling route behavior.

cheng: yep — rollback ready: pinned model -> hippo-fp32-2026-02 in traffic policy if needed.

maya: thanks, will stand by.
